title: SSH & Web Security Overview
description: SOC view of SSH authentication and web traffic in index project_1 (Buttercup Games tutorial data).

options.query: index=project_1 sourcetype=secure-2 "password for" | rex "\d\d:\d\d:\d\d (?<dest>\S+) sshd\[\d+\]: (?<action>Failed|Accepted) password for (?<invalid>invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>[\d\.]+) port" | where action="Failed" | stats count as "Failed SSH logins"

index=project_1 sourcetype=secure-2 "password for" | rex "\d\d:\d\d:\d\d (?<dest>\S+) sshd\[\d+\]: (?<action>Failed|Accepted) password for (?<invalid>invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>[\d\.]+) port" | where action="Accepted" | stats count as "Successful SSH logins"

index=project_1 sourcetype=secure-2 "password for" | rex "\d\d:\d\d:\d\d (?<dest>\S+) sshd\[\d+\]: (?<action>Failed|Accepted) password for (?<invalid>invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>[\d\.]+) port" | where action="Failed" | stats dc(src_ip) as "Attacking IPs"

index=project_1 sourcetype=secure-2 "password for" | rex "\d\d:\d\d:\d\d (?<dest>\S+) sshd\[\d+\]: (?<action>Failed|Accepted) password for (?<invalid>invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>[\d\.]+) port" | where isnotnull(invalid) | stats count as "Invalid-user attempts"

index=project_1 sourcetype=secure-2 "password for" | rex "\d\d:\d\d:\d\d (?<dest>\S+) sshd\[\d+\]: (?<action>Failed|Accepted) password for (?<invalid>invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>[\d\.]+) port" | where isnotnull(action) | timechart count by action

index=project_1 sourcetype=secure-2 "password for" | rex "\d\d:\d\d:\d\d (?<dest>\S+) sshd\[\d+\]: (?<action>Failed|Accepted) password for (?<invalid>invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>[\d\.]+) port" | where action="Failed" | stats count as "Failed logins" by dest | rename dest as Host | sort -"Failed logins"

index=project_1 sourcetype=secure-2 "password for" | rex "\d\d:\d\d:\d\d (?<dest>\S+) sshd\[\d+\]: (?<action>Failed|Accepted) password for (?<invalid>invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>[\d\.]+) port" | where action="Failed" | bin _time span=5m | stats count as failed dc(user) as users by _time src_ip | where failed>=10 | stats count as "5-min bursts" sum(failed) as "Failed logins" max(users) as "Max usernames tried" latest(_time) as last_seen by src_ip | eval "Last seen"=strftime(last_seen,"%F %T") | fields - last_seen | rename src_ip as "Source IP" | sort -"Failed logins" | head 15

index=project_1 sourcetype=secure-2 "password for" | rex "\d\d:\d\d:\d\d (?<dest>\S+) sshd\[\d+\]: (?<action>Failed|Accepted) password for (?<invalid>invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>[\d\.]+) port" | where action="Failed" | iplocation src_ip | stats count as "Failed logins" by Country | sort -"Failed logins" | head 10

index=project_1 sourcetype=secure-2 "password for" | rex "\d\d:\d\d:\d\d (?<dest>\S+) sshd\[\d+\]: (?<action>Failed|Accepted) password for (?<invalid>invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>[\d\.]+) port" | where isnotnull(invalid) | stats count as Attempts by user | sort -Attempts | head 10 | rename user as Username
index=project_1 sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie status>=400 | stats count as Requests by status | sort status | eval status=tostring(status)

index=project_1 sourcetype=access_combined_wcookie status>=400 | stats count as Errors dc(uri_path) as "Distinct URIs" dc(status) as "Status codes" values(method) as Methods by clientip | where Errors>=20 | sort -Errors | rename clientip as "Client IP" | head 15

index=project_1 sourcetype=secure-2 "password for" | rex "\d\d:\d\d:\d\d (?<dest>\S+) sshd\[\d+\]: (?<action>Failed|Accepted) password for (?<invalid>invalid user )?(?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>[\d\.]+) port" | stats count(eval(action="Failed")) as failed count(eval(action="Accepted")) as accepted values(eval(if(action="Accepted",user,null()))) as users by src_ip | where failed>=5 AND accepted>0 | rename src_ip as "Source IP", failed as "Failed", accepted as "Accepted", users as "Accounts accessed"
